svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: The separate --admission flag runs a secondary fixed-RAM experiment using the pre-candidate frozen ADMISSION.json (SHA256 2214a4a68dd3ba7a4d2f5441bb693e8e85d7d149ad6faa1553d6147997a06378). This does not change the primary matrix. Setup/tab creation, warmup, measured tasks and controls all pass through the same fresh-sampled admission controller in both arms. The controller uses a 1536 MiB watermark, 128 MiB in-flight reservations, a permanently reserved 128 MiB serial tab-keepalive worker, 180-second admission deadlines, and a 900-second cell deadline. All memory/CPU includes keepalive work; waits during measured tasks remain in their latency and throughput. Every admission and release forces a responsibility-family sample, so measurement overhead is intentionally included and reported. Setup failure cannot be repaired by reducing physical tab count. Ineligible cells stay in the matrix; passing a subset does not prove a full-matrix 2× target. The prepared command is:
